## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

Top-down survival in a dark arena with fog, blood decals, neon/sunset palette. Player in center-ish, camera follows with arena bounds larger than viewport (e.g. 2400x2400), camera zoom. Hordes spawn from edges. WASD movement, mouse aim, click/hold shoot, R reload, Space dash maybe. Three weapons: Pistol (infinite reserve? ammo), Shotgun, SMG (or rifle). Switch with 1/2/3 or scroll. ## Objective
- Build a complete, functional 2D top-down zombie survival game called ZOMBIE OUTBREAK in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.
- The user requires real gameplay and testing of all combat systems, not a static demo.

## Requirements
- Responsive movement and aiming.
- Multiple zombie types with different AI behaviors.
- Three functional weapons.
- Reloading, health, and ammunition systems.
- Endless waves with increasing difficulty.
- Coins, upgrades, and power-ups.
- Boss zombie every five waves.
- Particle effects, damage feedback, and screen shake.
- Mobile joystick and shooting controls.
- Main menu, pause, game-over, and restart screens.
- Test all combat systems and fix bugs.

## Decisions
- Built as a static HTML5 Canvas game with ES modules, no build step or external assets.
- Synthesized all audio at runtime with WebAudio.
- Split code into `index.html`, `css/style.css`, and `js/{utils,data,audio,input,entities,game}.js`.
- Weave avatar world coordinate system with a 2800×2800 arena, camera follow, keyboard/mouse + touch dual-stick controls.
- Five zombie types: walker, runner, spitter, brute, screamer, plus rotating boss names every five waves.
- Three weapons: Ranger M9 pistol (infinite reserve), Marrow 12 shotgun, Vector 9 SMG.
- Upgrades are offered as three purchasable cards between waves, one purchase per break.
- Power-ups: rapid fire, overcharge damage, shield, cryo freeze, dirty bomb.
- Added an automated test/debug hook at `window.__ZO__` with snapshot, spawn, damage, wave control, and upgrade helpers.
- Profiling showed software-rendered Playwright/Xvfb is extremely slow; optimized with a cached floor texture, cached light/flash sprites, removal of scanline CSS, throttled HUD updates, and menu render throttling.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full UI/UX markup and extensive responsive styling in `index.html` and `css/style.css`.
- Static game data, audio engine, input (keyboard/mouse/touch joysticks), player, zombies, boss AI, game engine, rendering, UI, particle/decal effects, wave logic, upgrades, power-ups, pause/game-over/restart, HUD.
- Server running on port 3002 (`tmux` session `zo`, log `/tmp/zo-server.log`).
- Menu and gameplay screenshots captured at `/tmp/zo-shots/01-menu.png` and `/tmp/zo-shots/02-play.png`; visual style inspected and looks good.
- Multiple runtime bugs fixed: missing `updateZombies`, missing `shake`, typo `segCirclePoint` → `segCircle`.
- Performance optimizations partially applied; gameplay improved from ~2.4 fps to ~6.5 fps in software rendering before latest HUD-throttling edits.

### Active
- Rewriting `updateHUD` to use the newly added `hudCache` and `cardCache` to eliminate per-frame DOM writes; constructor/caches and throttling framework are in place but `updateHUD` still needs to be converted.
- Re-testing after HUD throttling; previous issue was zombies not spawning within 2.5 s because game time advanced very slowly due to low FPS.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rewrite `Game.updateHUD()` in `js/game.js` to use `this.hudCache` and `this.cardCache`; only touch DOM when values change.
2. Remove `backdrop-filter` from HUD panels and simplify/remove `.fx-vignette` if needed for performance.
3. Run `node --check js/*.js` and re-run `/tmp/zo-perf8.mjs` / `/tmp/zo-perf7.mjs` to verify performance.
4. Re-run `/tmp/zo-smoke.mjs`; ensure zombies spawn, then create full combat test script covering weapons, reload, damage, kills, coins, intermission upgrades, boss wave 5, pause, game over, restart, and mobile controls.
5. Inspect new screenshots at desktop and mobile sizes; fix visual/gameplay bugs.
6. Verify final game end-to-end and report completion.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: main engine; HUD throttling edits underway; most logic/render lives here.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/entities.js`: Player and Zombie classes, AI, boss attacks, vector rendering.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: weapon/zombie/boss/upgrade/power-up definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: keyboard, mouse, touch joysticks, action buttons.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized WebAudio SFX/ambience.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/utils.js`: math, swept collision, helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all screens, HUD, overlays, mobile controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: theme, HUD, menu, upgrade, game-over, responsive/mobile styling.
- `/tmp/zo-smoke.mjs`: basic Playwright smoke test + screenshots.
- `/tmp/zo-perf7.mjs`, `/tmp/zo-perf8.mjs`: performance profiling scripts.
- `/tmp/zo-shots/`: captured menu/gameplay screenshots.

## Important Context
- Run server: `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=$RUNTIME_DIR ./start.sh` in tmux; currently active in session `zo`.
- Playwright runtime config is at `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`; use `createRequire(join(runtime,'package.json'))` to import `playwright`.
- Set `DISPLAY` from `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/display`.
- Software rendering under Xvfb is slow; measure with `requestAnimationFrame` FPS.
- Profiling after floor caching: baseline 6.5 fps; disabling CSS vignette +3.8, floor blit +5.3, HUD DOM +11.4, render-all 59.3.
- HUD updates were the largest remaining cost once many entities exist; constructor fields `hudTimer`, `hudCache`, `cardCache`, `lastMinimap`, `lastDamageOpacity` were just added.

- No git commit has been made; workspace changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build and fully verify ZOMBIE OUTBREAK, a playable 2D top-down zombie survival game in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, covering all combat systems and responsive controls.

## Requirements
- Responsive movement and aiming.
- Multiple zombie types with distinct AI.
- Three functional weapons, reloading, health, ammunition.
- Endless waves with increasing difficulty; boss every five waves.
- Coins, upgrades, power-ups.
- Particle effects, damage feedback, screen shake.
- Mobile dual-stick movement/aim/fire controls.
- Main menu, how-to, pause, upgrade, game-over, restart screens.
- Test all combat systems and fix bugs.

## Decisions
- Static HTML5 Canvas game with ES modules and no build step/assets.
- Runtime-synthesized WebAudio soundtrack/SFX.
- Files split across `index.html`, `css/style.css`, and `js/{utils,data,audio,input,entities,game}.js`.
- Arena is 2800×2800 with camera follow and keyboard/mouse + touch input.
- Five zombie types plus rotating bosses every five waves.
- Weapons: Ranger M9 pistol (infinite reserve), Marrow 12 shotgun, Vector 9 SMG.
- One purchasable upgrade per intermission from three generated offers.
- Exposed `window.__ZO__` test/debug API, including a new deterministic `step(seconds, dt)` helper and `givePower(id)`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game, UI, rendering, enemy AI, bosses, weapons, pickups, upgrades, audio, particles, and responsive layouts implemented.
- Fixed missing `updateZombies`, missing `shake`, and `segCircle` typos.
- Cached HUD/card DOM updates; removed gameplay HUD `backdrop-filter`; raised software-rendered FPS from ~6.5 to ~8.8.
- Fixed HUD pause/mute buttons being unclickable because `.hud` has `pointer-events: none`; added `#btn-mute, #btn-pause { pointer-events: auto; }`.
- Fixed mobile portrait title clipping and HUD/action/weapon-card overlaps.
- Added landscape mobile layout: hides minimap, centers weapon cards between joysticks, repositions actions/power chips.
- Normalized player aim angle after updates.
- `node --check` passes for all JS files.
- Combat suite `/tmp/zo-combat.mjs`: **78 passed, 0 failed**, no page/console errors.
- UI suite `/tmp/zo-ui.mjs`: **33 passed, 0 failed**, no page/console errors.
- Verified pistol, shotgun, SMG, auto-reload, damage/shield/health, all five power-ups, all zombie AIs, dash, HUD live values, wave spawning, upgrades, pause/resume/restart, bosses at waves 5 and 10, game over, desktop/mobile/landscape UI.
- Server active on `http://localhost:3002` in tmux session `zo`; assets return HTTP 200.

### Active
- Final end-to-end review and completion report.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally rerun `/tmp/zo-smoke.mjs`, `/tmp/zo-combat.mjs`, and `/tmp/zo-ui.mjs` after any further edits.
2. Report completion with implemented features and test results; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: engine, waves, combat, UI orchestration, debug hook.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/entities.js`: player and zombie classes, AI, boss attacks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: weapons, enemies, bosses, upgrades, power-ups.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: keyboard, mouse, touch joysticks/actions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: theme, responsive HUD/mobile/landscape layouts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: screens and HUD markup.
- `/tmp/zo-combat.mjs`: 78-check gameplay/combat suite.
- `/tmp/zo-ui.mjs`: 33-check screen/button/responsive suite.
- `/tmp/zo-shots/`: final desktop/mobile/landscape screenshots.
- `/tmp/zo-server.log`: server log.

## Important Context
- Run server with `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=$RUNTIME_DIR ./start.sh`; currently in tmux session `zo`.
- Playwright config lives at `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`; set `DISPLAY` from `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/display`.
- Software rendering under Xvfb is ~8.8 FPS, so use the debug `step()` helper for deterministic timing tests instead of relying on real-time waits.
- Keep a distant high-health “anchor” zombie during isolated tests so unintended wave clears do not switch mode to `intermission`.
- Debug API includes `snapshot`, `start`, `startWave`, `spawn`, `spawnAt`, `step`, `givePower`, `killAll`, `damagePlayer`, `addCoins`, `buy`, `nextWave`, `forceIntermission`, `pause`, `resume`, `teleport`, `setupTouch`.
- Workspace files are all untracked; no git commit has been made.
